snippet.title: SHIFT AT MIDNIGHT - RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
snippet.description:
Shift At Midnight is an online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

Wishlist Shift At Midnight here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722330/Shift_At_Midnight/
